answer: Timing is the cheapest tax. The beacon cuts each six-hour epoch into as many slots as there are registered keys and hashes every key into one, unknown until the beacon lands. An attestation counts only when signed inside its own slot. Miss it and that identity earns nothing that epoch, however much it read. Five thousand fake keys means five thousand processes awake from dawn until the window shuts, each surfacing at an unpredictable minute, and one crashed host silences a block. A farm of many names is a fable told by one reader. The cipher is the schedule, and reading does not fan out.
